items.title: Behringer Kick is a sampler with vibe-coded firmware at its core: Is this really the future we want?
items.excerpt: Behringer's in-development open-source sampler Kick is pitched around AI-generated firmware: 'With AI, even people without programming experience can turn their ideas into new features and firmware.' It also lists an 'AI camera' for gesture control.

history_match.title: Vibe coding is turning the music gear world upside down

items.title: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
items.excerpt: The MPC Sample Key will be an open-source 37-key take on Akai's budget MPC Sample, with firmware opened so users can vibe-code new instruments and features with AI coding tools.

history_match.title: Who's Buying All These Vibe-Coded Plugins?

items.title: Akai kicks back? Sample Key teaser lands a day after Behringer's open-source Kick
items.excerpt: Akai says it is 'embracing the AI and vibe-coding community' by opening Sample Key's firmware; teaser videos show staff using Claude to turn it into a chord machine and units running custom vibe-coded VA, FM and wavetable synths. (Same story as The Verge item - alternate source.)

history_match.title: Vibe coding is turning the music gear world upside down

items.title: AI takes the stage with BSO musicians in Tod Machover's wild world premiere
items.excerpt: MIT Media Lab composer Tod Machover's 25-minute 'already and not yet' puts 80-plus Boston Symphony Orchestra players in dialogue with a live AI system that responds to each musician's performance.

items.title: Russia's media regulator blocks viral AI-generated song 'You're My Scumbag' on streaming services
items.excerpt: The viral AI-generated song 'Ty moya...' by DJ NARODNII has been blocked on Russian streaming services by the media regulator.

items.title: 사람보다 더 잘 듣는 AI 개발한다…MIT 스마라그디스 교수, 음원 분리·음성 인식·환경 소리 분석 기술 개발
items.excerpt: MIT의 파리 스마라그디스 교수 연구팀이 음원 분리, 음성 인식, 환경 소리 분석을 아우르는 '사람보다 더 잘 듣는' 청각 AI 연구를 소개했다.

items.title: SMEBench: Benchmarking Neural Music Editing with Synthetized MIDI Edits
items.excerpt: A large-scale benchmark of controlled music edits built by modifying symbolic MIDI performances and rendering matched source/target audio, covering twelve instrumentation, articulation and dynamics edit types for evaluating instruction-based neural music editors.

items.title: ChoreoStudio: Planning What, When, and Who in Music-Driven Group Choreography
items.excerpt: ChoreoStudio makes choreography planning explicit for music-driven group dance generation, aligning formation transitions with high-level musical structure (intro to chorus to climax) and deciding which dancer executes each transition.

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple Amid Ugly Subpoena Dispute
items.excerpt: Suno is firing back against Apple's motion to quash a deposition subpoena concerning major-label licensing talks, AI fraud and more in the UMG/Sony case. (Litigation angle - deprioritized.)

history_match.title: Suno v. MLC Subpoena Dispute Boils Over as AI Platform Demands Multiple Years of DSP-Specific Streaming Data

items.title: ICMP Says Australian Songs Used to Train AI Sans Compensation
items.excerpt: ICMP warns that Australian copyright law risks being watered down for AI training, saying major hits by Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave were already used to train AI without consent.

history_match.title: ARIA boss warns Australian politicians on AI lobbying demands

items.title: AI-Generated Music and the Future of Creativity Discussed at Billboard Latin Music Week
items.excerpt: A Billboard Latin Music Week panel with SGAE's Cristina Perpiñá-Robert and Pierre Hachar Jr. weighed how to protect human creators as AI-generated songs spread, including Spain's concerns about AI replacing creators.

items.title: Google's Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
items.excerpt: DeepMind's Genie 4 research preview generates real-time audio matched to the simulated world, including music, ambient sound and dialogue, while users steer scenes with mid-simulation prompts. (Music is a secondary angle; likely also a games/gadgets candidate.)
